after.name: Maker
after.description: Issue #629 -- who makes the item the requester wants, typed beside its Size on the request form, and optional: blank is an item with no maker named. Kept as Size is (lib/typedText.js:normalizeItemText): the ends trimmed, runs of spaces collapsed, case as typed, and compared without regard to case. Part of what an item is: Materials tells items apart by Category, Size, Maker and Unit (lib/materialIdentity.js), so two makers' versions of one item are two materials with prices of their own, and two request rows differing only in it are not merged. Copied into PO Items when the order is generated and printed on the order the vendor receives. A signer changes it through Edit and continue, which logs it as Maker in PR Edit Log.

after.name: Maker
after.description: Issue #629 -- frozen copy of the PR Item's Maker, written with the rest of the snapshot by lib/poGeneration.js and never changed after. Printed in the order document's MAKER column, beside SIZE (lib/poPdf.js). Blank where the request named no maker. Invoice Items and Delivery Items copy it from here.

after.description: Issue #629 -- frozen copy of the linked PO Item's Maker, as Size and Unit are: reference-only, with no edit path. Blank where the order named no maker.

after.description: Issue #629 -- frozen copy of the linked PO Item's Maker, as Item Name, Size and Unit are: reference-only, with no edit path. Blank where the order named no maker.

after.name: Maker
after.description: Issue #629 -- part of the natural key, Category + Size + Maker + Unit. Written once, by upsertMaterial, from the ordered item that made the row: trimmed, runs of spaces collapsed, case as typed, and matched without regard to case (lib/materialIdentity.js). Blank is a material with no maker named, which every row made before #629 is. Material Label carries it between Size and Unit.

before: The catalog path this material IS (#356). Half the natural key, with Size and Unit — identity was the item name somebody typed until this field, so two spellings of one thing were two rows with separate price histories behind them. SINGLE record, enforced by this app rather than by the schema, since prefersSingleRecordLink is refused on both CREATE and UPDATE. Item Name is a lookup through this link and no longer text anyone writes, so a row with no category has no name at all: upsertMaterial refuses one.
after: The catalog path this material IS (#356). Part of the natural key, with Size, Maker (#629) and Unit — identity was the item name somebody typed until this field, so two spellings of one thing were two rows with separate price histories behind them. SINGLE record, enforced by this app rather than by the schema, since prefersSingleRecordLink is refused on both CREATE and UPDATE. Item Name is a lookup through this link and no longer text anyone writes, so a row with no category has no name at all: upsertMaterial refuses one.

before:
Issue #162 — frozen reference copies, taken from the linked PO Item, or from the Material when there is no PO Item. Reference-only: no edit path, and a mismatch against the PO line means the wrong line was allocated — same convention as Invoice Items. Unlike Invoice Items these are never blank, since a Material is always linked and carries all three as its natural key.

Unit is the shared canonical select (lib/units.js CANONICAL_UNITS). This table is the FIFTH on that list after PR Items, PO Items, Invoice Items and Materials; all 19 options must exist here before the first write, because typecast is deliberately not used and a missing option fails the write.

Item Name, Size, Maker (#629) and Unit are copied together, and Size and Maker are blank where the ordered item's are.
